description: Policy CANONICAL DUY NHAT cho quy trinh AI PR Review (AI_PR_REVIEWER Issue #2 + Issue #5). Repo du an khong giu ban sao; tham chieu + pin version qua projectPolicyContract. Mo hinh reviewer hai giai doan (transition/steadyState) theo [USER-DECISION] tren Issue duongpdddic-droid/AI_PR_REVIEWER#2 (comment id 5381416494); contract reviewer-coder va discovery task fail-closed theo [GPT-REV-036]/[GPT-REV-037].

scope.note: Ban canonical duy nhat nam tai repo nay (.github/ai-review-policy.json). Repo du an (vd QLDA_DTXD) KHONG mirror file nay; chi giu .github/project-review-policy.json khai bao policySource + pinnedVersion + projectOverrides. Effective policy = global (canonical) + project overrides CHI tren allowedProjectOverrides.

projectPolicyContract.source: [Issue #5] Centralize coder-reviewer protocol — AI_PR_REVIEWER la Single Source of Truth
projectPolicyContract.precedenceNote: Project override KHONG BAO GIO ghi de global invariant/quy trinh review; chi dinh nghia gia tri project-specific cho cac khoa trong allowedProjectOverrides.

failClosed.BLOCKED_CANONICAL_UNAVAILABLE: Canonical policy khong doc duoc (missing/unreachable/unparseable) -> BLOCKED, khong approve, khong dung ban local cu.
failClosed.BLOCKED_CANONICAL_INVALID: Canonical policy khong pass validatePolicy -> BLOCKED.
failClosed.BLOCKED_POLICY_DUPLICATE_KEYS: Canonical policy co duplicate JSON keys (vd khai lai canonicalRepo) -> schema mo ho -> BLOCKED. [GPT-REV-045]
failClosed.BLOCKED_VERSION_MISMATCH: projectConfig.policySource.pinnedVersion != canonical.policyVersion -> BLOCKED, phai bump pin cung canonical.
failClosed.BLOCKED_INVALID_OVERRIDE: Override khoa khong thuoc allowedProjectOverrides -> BLOCKED.

requiredChecksNote: Ten chinh xac cua check-run trong .github/workflows/verify.yml (job id/name: 'verify' / 'Verify CI'). Thieu/sai ten = CI_UNKNOWN fail-closed.
finalReviewerNote: Gia tri nay la reviewer cuoi cho GIAI DOAN CHUYEN TIEP (transition) — xem reviewerPhases. O steady state reviewer mac dinh la reviewer:local theo dieu kien approvalRequiresAllGates.

authority.finalApprovalNote: Giai doan transition. Steady state: reviewer:local duoc phep approve khi du toan bo reviewerPhases.steadyState.approvalRequiresAllGates.
authority.approversNote: [GPT-REV-049] Allowlist DANH TINH duoc phep dang GPT approval marker (reviewer:agent:gpt) hoac wiring GPT approval. Chi nhung binh luan do login thuoc danh sach nay moi hop le (fail-closed: author bat ky khac bi tu choi UNAUTHORIZED_ACTOR). GPT approval la quyet dinh relay boi nguoi dung, nen approvers la tai khoan nguoi dung (duongpdddic-droid) — KHONG phai bat ky actor/bot nao.

reviewerPhases.source: [USER-DECISION] Mo hinh reviewer muc tieu sau Issue #2 — duongpdddic-droid/AI_PR_REVIEWER#2, comment id 5381416494 (22/08/2026)

transition.appliesWhile: Issue duongpdddic-droid/AI_PR_REVIEWER#2 chua hoan thanh: runtime wiring (unified-orchestrator.mjs / review-contract.mjs / gpt-approval.mjs) chua duoc trien khai qua PR rieng duoc GPT duyet va merge
transition.rationale: AI_PR_REVIEWER khong tu chung nhan ban thay doi kien truc reviewer cua chinh no; local chi pre-review/ho tro. Hai PR contract/fix chi duoc merge sau khi GPT duet dung HEAD SHA va nguoi dung cho phep; viec merge hai PR nay KHONG tu kich hoat steady-state.

steadyState.appliesAfter: Issue duongpdddic-droid/AI_PR_REVIEWER#2 hoan thanh: PR runtime wiring thu ba da duoc GPT duyet dung full HEAD SHA va nguoi dung merge (khong tu kich hoat khi hai PR contract/fix merge)

activationEvidence.note: [GPT-REV-045]+[GPT-REV-046] Nguon kich hoat may doc duoc CO AUTHORITY, fail-closed: MOT comment tren Issue nay chua marker prefix + JSON {phase:'steady-state', wiringPr, wiringMergedSha (full 40-hex), gptApprovedHeadSha (full 40-hex), recordedBy, recordedAt}. Orchestrator KHONG tin truong tu khai bao trong body: author comment phai thuoc allowedRecorders; wiringPr phai dung expectedWiringPr; wiring PR phai MERGED that (doc tu GitHub REST, merged=true) voi merge_commit_sha khop wiringMergedSha va head sha khop gptApprovedHeadSha; tren wiring PR phai co GPT approval marker hop le (reviewer agent:gpt, khoa dung head da merge + policyVersion hien tai, khong con finding blocking). Nhieu marker mau thuan / thieu quyen / sai bat ky dieu kien / API loi -> giu transition, tuyet doi khong local approve.

steadyState.escalationBehavior: Bat ky truong hop escalation/thieu bang chung/xung dot/nghi van approval -> fail-closed: khong approve, chuyen GPT (agent:gpt) hoac status:blocked hoi nguoi dung. Nguoi dung van la nguoi quyet merge va deploy.

reviewerCoderContract.source: [GPT-REV-036] PR duongpdddic-droid/QLDA_DTXD#42 — Reviewer <-> Coder protocol bat buoc
reviewerCoderContract.findingRequiredFieldsNote: Finding thieu bat ky truong nao -> finding KHONG hop le, coder co the REBUT voi ly do 'malformed-finding'; reviewer phai xac nhan va cap nhat finding truoc khi dem lai blocking.
reviewerCoderContract.findingCodeFormat: (GPT|LOCAL)-REV-NNN hoac (GPT|LOCAL)-RULE-NNN; Cline phan hoi bang CLINE-FIX-NNN hoac CLINE-REBUT-NNN.
reviewerCoderContract.coderVerdictsNote: CLINE-FIX-NNN = da sua + commit + evidence test. CLINE-REBUT-NNN = phan bien van de moi (evidence cu the: code/API/test/so lieu); REBUT khong duoc dung de tu resolve thread khi chua co bang chung.
reviewerCoderContract.rebuttalHandlingNote: Reviewer BAT BUOC xu ly moi CLINE-REBUT-NNN bang ACCEPTED (dong finding/ghi nhan lap luan) hoac REJECTED (tra loi tung diem bang evidence). Im lang = chua xu ly = finding van con mo.
reviewerCoderContract.unresolvedDisputeBehavior: Bất đồng không phân xử được sau 1 vòng REBUT->REJECTED (coder vẫn chưa đồng ý hoặc thiếu bằng chứng kết luận) -> fail-closed: chuyển agent:gpt hoặc status:blocked hỏi người dùng; CẤM coder tự đóng thread/tự gắn approved.

minimalCommandDiscovery.source: [GPT-REV-037] PR duongpdddic-droid/QLDA_DTXD#42 — prompt toi thieu + task discovery fail-closed
minimalCommandDiscovery.minimalCommandsNote: Hai câu lệnh TƯƠNG ĐƯƠNG tuyệt đối; cả Coder và Reviewer hiểu cùng một nghĩa: tự khám phá trạng thái rồi tiếp tục, không cần người dùng nhớ số Issue/PR.
minimalCommandDiscovery.discoveryOrderNote: Agent tự đối chiếu repo/origin -> Memory Bank -> GitHub (Issue/PR/HEAD/CI/findings) trước khi hỏi người dùng bất kỳ số hiệu nào; stale checkpoint trong Memory Bank KHÔNG BAO GIỜ thắng trạng thái GitHub thật.

zeroTaskBehavior.note: Không có Issue agent:cline+status:ready-for-cline và không có checkpoint dang dở -> báo NO_TASK, KHÔNG mutation.

oneTaskBehavior.note: Đúng một task hợp lệ -> claim đúng task đó (preflight PASS) và thực thi.

manyOrConflictingTaskBehavior.note: Nhiều task hợp lệ hoặc task mâu thuẫn nhau -> status:blocked hỏi người dùng chọn; KHÔNG đoán, KHÔNG tự chọn.
